title: Stateless — Preserve Sol grant lineage through host-rejected successor authorship
body:
The user has authorized proceeding with the source-grounded remaining-issues sequence. This issue commissions the first bounded implementation: restore ordinary successor authorship after an otherwise eligible Sol host-rejected response. ChatGPT/Work owns scope and evidence review; local Codex owns current-source diagnosis, implementation, verification and one Draft PR.

## Entry and observed problem

Use only `hynk-studio/augnes` at `/Users/hynk/code/augnes`. Current authenticated main is `84105ccc5df47ba56477fa5ed04ec2e030708b54`, tree `ccb0c99948bdd5e94fcb18703420aeefd877813b`. Aggregate #1404 is merged, and its tree matches the previously verified `820249de35a27df5f25c99bdac9bde5873278724` tip. Start a new bounded branch from freshly confirmed main; do not stack on or alter the superseded incremental PRs.

Reconfirm physical root/origin, branch, HEAD/base, worktree state, development ownership and verification/process ownership before development. The remote inspection cannot establish current Mac ownership. Preserve unrelated changes and active work. Read AGENTS, relevant active 01/02/03/04 owners and the current Local Canonical policy. This is source-first defect work with owned disposable fixtures, not resumption or mutation of the retained real candidate.

At the inspected main:

- `lib/vnext/runtime/stateless-source-review.ts` constructs each model invocation grant from the validated historical request's limits. The Sol low-reasoning profile has 4,096 output tokens and 60,000 ms per invocation.
- `lib/vnext/runtime/stateless-terminal-authorship.ts:readTerminalAttemptHistory` reconstructs that grant using legacy `STATELESS_LIMITS`: 1,024 output tokens and 15,000 ms.
- `buildModelInvocationCapabilityGrantV01` includes these limits in the lineage fingerprint. Terminal authorship requires the saved receipt's grant lineage to match the reconstructed grant.
- Therefore an otherwise eligible Sol response that completed at the Gateway but was rejected by host validation is expected to fail historical receipt verification. `readTerminalAuthorshipPreparation` catches the failure and returns null.
- The Sol `public-bound` test verifies retained rejection diagnostics but does not assert terminal preparation or successful ordinary successor authorship. Positive terminal-authorship fixtures use the default mini route.

This is a source-confirmed inconsistency. ChatGPT has NOT run the authenticated HTTP reproduction or Mac tests. Earlier Canonical PASS records do not disprove the missing composition case and are not deciding evidence for this future fix.

Primary inspected sources:
- [execution owner](https://github.com/hynk-studio/augnes/blob/84105ccc5df47ba56477fa5ed04ec2e030708b54/lib/vnext/runtime/stateless-source-review.ts#L338)
- [historical terminal reader](https://github.com/hynk-studio/augnes/blob/84105ccc5df47ba56477fa5ed04ec2e030708b54/lib/vnext/runtime/stateless-terminal-authorship.ts#L60)
- [Sol test coverage](https://github.com/hynk-studio/augnes/blob/84105ccc5df47ba56477fa5ed04ec2e030708b54/scripts/test-stateless-source-review.ts#L954)

## Required result

1. Reproduce or refute the failure before fixing it through the real ordinary authenticated authorization/handler path, a scripted Sol transport, a host-validation rejection and saved review readback. Use no real provider credentials or outbound provider calls; keep the existing isolated scripted transport. Observe the actual missing terminal preparation or exact historical-verification failure; do not manufacture positive receipts, grants or DB lineage.

2. Make historical grant reconstruction agree with the immutable grant that actually authorized the invocation. Preserve exact original scope, limits, time, control revision, purpose, identity, cost authority and lineage. Choose the smallest sufficient implementation from current source. Reuse a shared owner if it reduces drift without broad refactoring. Do not solve this by hardcoding Sol limits, trusting current environment configuration, weakening fingerprint validation or adding a permissive fallback.

3. Exercise Sol rejection at both first judgment and final judgment where the existing terminal contract permits it. Through saved review and ordinary compare/preview/author operations, produce a separate linked successor with null execution grant and preserved failure attribution. Verify durable authorship/currentness and readback from a fresh process. Existing UI consumption should expose the preparation without requiring a new surface; exercise its existing focused coverage when needed.

4. Preserve mini-route and historical compatibility, including historical grants without newer optional configuration/note fields where already supported. Historical authority must be validated from its original record even after the invocation grant expires; it must never be renewed or reinterpreted as current permission. Keep historical packets, grants, receipts, rejection evidence, unknown effects/costs and original run/step state unchanged.

5. Keep existing refusal boundaries. Gateway failures/incomplete responses, unknown dispatch, local result-persistence failure, receipt-projection failure and recovery-suspended mutation remain outside this terminal exception. Supported legacy rejection evidence that was never recorded must remain explicitly unavailable and keep its existing historical eligibility; do not backfill its contents. Corrupt evidence, tampered grant/receipt lineage, wrong project/principal, stale preview/selection and source/direction changes must still refuse where required. Exact idempotent authorship replay retains its existing behavior and never creates duplicate work or replays a provider call. Select meaningful existing and focused negative checks; do not expand this issue into general failure recovery.

6. Update current semantic/evaluation/usage wording only where this correction changes or clarifies the actual contract. Do not undertake broad Current/Draft reconciliation or close predecessor issues/PRs in this change.

## Verification and delivery

Use the repository's existing fixture, authenticated-handler, lifecycle and cleanup owners. A new regression should demonstrate the pre-fix failure and post-fix ordinary-path result. Report separate stages: response received, host validation rejected it, failure evidence saved, historical grant validated, successor authored, fresh-process readback. Host rejection remains a failed prior attempt; successor creation is not successful execution or accepted semantic state.

Run necessary focused checks and ask the current Local Canonical planner for the final exact clean head against freshly authenticated current main. Follow its selected scope using the supported executor and current Node/platform policy. Do not substitute the old stack receipt, a Linux run, a synthetic merge identity or a direct test-helper result for required deciding evidence. Preserve all failed/interrupted targets and logs; do not retry an unchanged failed deciding target merely for PASS or weaken acceptance. If a concrete correction changes source, it creates a new target.

Return one Draft PR targeting main, with exact base/head, observed reproduction, root cause, changed behavior, historical/authority compatibility, focused checks, planner-selected deciding receipt and validation, cleanup/ownership release, and remaining limitations. Keep auto-merge disabled and this issue open for review. No merge or Ready transition.

Batch the authorized investigation, reversible source changes, necessary verification and Draft PR preparation without routine intermediate permission requests. If current source refutes this diagnosis, report the actual cause and smallest correction within this behavior; do not force the suspected mechanism.

## Scope boundary and subsequent sequence

Authorized here: local source implementation, owned disposable fixture stores/processes, required repository verification, and Draft PR preparation. No paid provider calls, retained-candidate or real-data mutation/migration, service installation, hosted migration/deployment, deletion, automation enablement, merge or repository-policy change.

After review, the next intended slice is actual native adoption and saved-work resumption: a concrete backup/recovery plan, compatible readers/clients, forward selection migration, fresh observations and refusal of held old requests. Later, continue one meaningful task across multiple work steps and then transfer the required working materials/state to a named environment. Those real-environment effects require their own concrete scope; this defect issue does not execute them.

Keep the broader findings available without bundling their implementation here:
- Existing stateless work already joins choose → observe → conclude under one authorization; the remaining progression burden is between work items.
- Source-bound imported handoffs still exclude direction/accepted-state/reviewed-outcome/nested content and refuse native execution.
- Scale limits are distinct: project packet reads 4,096 records/16 MiB; project-wide Core reads 4,096; one managed-run inspector scans the entire DB up to 4,096 before project evaluation; direction records share a 512-entry append ceiling; Web complete history is limited to 1,024 rows/1,400,000 bytes.
- These are source-observed operation limits, not observed exhaustion of the user's DB. Address concrete unavailable operations separately while preserving complete evidence and authority checks.
- P4.6's equal supported outcomes and lack of observed additional revision benefit remain unchanged.

Refs #1384, #1389, #1390, #1404.


**Independent post-implementation source review — 2026-10-05**

Reviewed Draft #1406 at `3fcdb0b8131aea4fab5ae98f693c11801ed076d9`, based on main `84105ccc5df47ba56477fa5ed04ec2e030708b54`. Fresh GitHub reads confirm those identities, open Draft status, `merged=false`, and `auto_merge=null`. All six retrieved changed files match their Git blob identities. This review inspected the complete diff, relevant execution/readback owners, new and modified regression paths, and their Canonical suite registration.

No additional blocking defect was identified within #1405's bounded scope:

- Execution and historical readback now share derivation from the validated original grant. Original limits, scope, control revision and dates are preserved. The caller still validates the immutable grant/packet, exact receipt lineage and cost authority; this helper does not authorize or renew execution.
- The new authenticated-handler regression covers both choose and conclude host rejections, saved-review preparation, ordinary compare/preview/author, a separate durable null-grant successor, exact replay, unchanged historical records, and no replay of the failed attempt. It includes expired original authority, changed current route/control, wrong authentication/principal/project, and corrupted grant/receipt/cost/evidence refusals.
- Fresh-process authenticated readback is exercised for both Sol cases. The separate focused Sol browser mode uses the existing actual component and HTTP fixture. The regular Canonical `--sol-low` entry invokes the new two-stage regression; the browser-specific mode is reported as a separate focused check.
- Mini and legacy coverage remains. The added pre-note case uses a pinned historical issuer/host instead of deleting fields or inventing a positive receipt. Supported unrecorded rejection evidence stays unavailable; malformed evidence still refuses. Recovery-suspended mutation and the other existing refusal boundaries remain.
- Active 02/04 additions describe historical verification and its limited acceptance meaning; they do not establish successful execution, accepted semantic state, or general failure recovery.

**Execution evidence boundary.** Local Codex reports pre-fix reproduction, focused PASS, one final exact-head planner-selected Canonical run with all 16 phases passing, receipt validation `valid_deciding_evidence=true` / `issues=[]`, preservation of earlier failures, clean checkout, released ownership and zero owned processes. These are executing-lane observations recorded in the PR. ChatGPT did not rerun Mac tests, independently validate the environment-bound receipt, or reobserve the local checkout/processes. The policy deliberately keeps raw receipts/logs local; no upload or replacement attestation is requested by this review.

**Disposition.** Accept this bounded source correction for the next integration decision. The defect is corrected in the reviewed Draft head, not yet in main. Keep #1405 open and #1406 Draft with auto-merge disabled. This checkpoint is not merge approval, native adoption, installation, live-provider qualification, migration or deployment.

The next useful local preparation is a concrete #1406 integration decision card plus a source-backed native adoption/saved-work-resumption preflight, reusing the existing #1403 compatibility obligations and #1393/#1399 owners. It must identify the actual intended target and compatible readers, fresh selection observations, writer coordination, backup/staged-recovery or roll-forward, and a bounded ordinary saved-work acceptance journey. Historical installation claims are not fresh observations. Source review and status collection must not start a runtime that opens or migrates a live store. Preserve protected retained-candidate boundaries; an unidentified or unapproved target remains unknown while the remaining plan is completed. Actual merge, service/DB changes, candidate operations and provider calls still need their specific authority. No new source change or broad Canonical rerun is commissioned merely to prepare this decision.


**Merged source closeout — 2026-10-06 KST**

The user merged #1406. Fresh GitHub inspection confirms ordinary merge `614d7407df97af9135976cef655653580964da67`, with parents `84105ccc5df47ba56477fa5ed04ec2e030708b54` and `3fcdb0b8131aea4fab5ae98f693c11801ed076d9`. Its tree `92dfeb7a20d6df13aad5757e2dfc596766d7228b` matches the independently reviewed implementation exactly. This bounded source correction is complete, so #1405 is closed as completed. Historical reproduction, failures, receipt identity and evidence limits remain intact.

The user states there is no pending work to resume and has approved the proposed Mac default-store + Companion + Browser + current Operator adoption. New Issue #1407 owns that bounded operational scope and a newly authored save/re-entry/revision journey. No installation or real-store adoption has been performed by ChatGPT through this closeout. General failure continuation, native/hosted qualification outside #1407, multi-step progression, semantic updating, transfer and the broader predecessor obligations remain unfinished; closing this narrow bug issue does not close them.
